existing_observations.text: The surface 'reasoned' carries two codes in two senses: G1256 (five verses, Paul reasoning with hearers in speech) and G3049 (1Cor 13:11, the reckoning of a child).

evidence.verse: And Paul went in, as was his custom, and on three Sabbath days he reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who happened to be there.
And he reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and tried to persuade Jews and Greeks.
And they came to Ephesus, and he left them there, but he himself went into the synagogue and reasoned with the Jews.
And as he reasoned about righteousness and self-control and the coming judgment, Felix was alarmed and said, “ Go away for the present. When I get an opportunity I will summon you.”

senses.obs_text: In Act 17:2, 17:17, 18:4, 18:19 and 24:25 the verb is Paul's speaking in debate: he argues from the Scriptures in the synagogue or the marketplace, and in Act 24:25 on righteousness, self-control and judgment to Felix; it is reasoning aimed at another person, with persuasion in view.

evidence.verse: And Peter went down to the men and said, “ I am the one you are looking for. What is the reason for your coming?”
When they had examined me, they wished to set me at liberty, because there was no reason for the death penalty in my case.
For this reason, therefore, I have asked to see you and speak with you, since it is because of the hope of Israel that I am wearing this chain.”

evidence.verse: At the end of the days I, Nebuchadnezzar, lifted my eyes to heaven, and my reason returned to me, and I blessed the Most High, and praised and honored him who lives forever, for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom endures from generation to generation;

At the same time my reason returned to me, and for the glory of my kingdom, my majesty and splendor returned to me. My counselors and my lords sought me, and I was established in my kingdom, and still more greatness was added to me.

senses.obs_text: In Dan 4:34 and 4:36 the noun is Nebuchadnezzar's understanding, which returns to him after the humbling; it names the mind's faculty of knowing as a thing lost and given back, in two verses that report the same restoration.

evidence.verse: and the plenty will be unknown in the land by reason of the famine that will follow, for it will be very severe.
Now there was no food in all the land, for the famine was very severe, so that the land of Egypt and the land of Canaan languished by reason of the famine.

senses.obs_text: In Gen 41:31 and 47:13 the phrase translated by reason of is the cause of a state: the famine that makes the plenty unknown in Egypt and the cause of the land's languishing; it names what causes, as in the other uses of the surface.
